name: ledgerpaper
title: Ledger Paper
summary: The app's own warm-paper palette: teal accent, hairline rules, serif headings
description: The palette Ledger already rendered before themes were installed, lifted verbatim from the --ledger-* block in theme/web/custom-variables.scss so the default theme reproduces the app's existing look rather than approximating it.

files.purpose: Layer 1 — the Ledgerpaper palette (light): brand, surfaces, ink, density
the Atlas wiring — shared by every mxcli theme, identical in each
the other palette, the variant blocks, @font-face, and this theme's own skin rules
the recipe layer — num / pill / stat / focus / density, shared by every theme
the widget-module layer — rules for colours Sass bakes before any token exists
variant switch + imports — this file compiles last, so the partials win
vendored Source Sans 3 + Source Serif 4 (SIL OFL 1.1, OFL-ledger.txt) — no CDN at runtime
